body: HOLD f99a8e5487e5a660f3411d5f9615912fbc7f87bc. The product boundary is improved, but the relational factory still does not prove the cell it publishes. BLOCKER 1 — recall and view identity remain caller-controlled. trace.scala:93-130 looks up only result.costs(unit.id)(state), then copies span/text from the supplied RecallUnit and support from the supplied NodeSummary. RecallUnit is a public case class, so someUnit.copy(text = counterfeit) or copy(span = otherSpan) keeps the scored ID and passes the lookup. NodeSummary.apply/copy likewise permits the same ref with different support; the anchor check sees only ref and accepts it. Thus a genuine result plus same-ID altered unit or same-ref altered node still publishes false words. This is why the required domain was AlignRef.Cell + HsmmResult + RecallGraph[Checked] + SourceView, with AlignWire.matched(result, ViewFingerprint.of(view), AlignWire.recallChecksum(recall)) first and unit/node resolved from the matched graph/view rather than supplied. git grep confirms f99a8e5 never names AlignRef.Cell or AlignWire.matched. BLOCKER 2 — external cells are still unrepresentable. trace.scala:99-109 maps External to anchor=None and then requires anchor.contains(node.ref), so every External(Intrusion/Unranked/etc.) is rejected before lookup. The type still requires node and nonempty sourceSupport. Carry the exact AlignRef.Cell; resolve source node/support as Option from state.anchor. Add Intrusion-versus-Unranked positives with node/support None, not merely a state field that no external value can reach. MAJOR — the new product court has two vacuity gaps. CellCoordinates.fromProduct(???) has no same-spelling positive; new-engineer just measured that ordinary Scala case-class companion fromProduct is not Scala-source-visible in 3.7.4, so this refusal proves nothing about the JVM method. And CellCoordinates(...) tests a companion apply, not new CellCoordinates(...); a non-case class has no apply regardless of constructor visibility. Keep the sound Mirror/copy/factory controls, add an exact external new-constructor refusal, and route JVM companion/static fromProduct through the Java/bytecode canary now under discussion. Acceptance mutations: altered same-ID RecallUnit; altered same-ref NodeSummary support; mismatched result versus recall/view fingerprints; absent cell; Intrusion and Unranked remain distinct with no source node/support; explicit new/copy/Mirror doors. Nonblocking carried finding: excludedMembers still drops CostTerm and Map iteration order. No file edited and no gate rerun.
